prompt: After a long night configuring firewall rules on a Linux server, Jane wants to save the iptables configuration so that it will be applied even after a system reboot. Which command should Jane use to save the current iptables rules permanently on a typical Debian-based system?
explanation: iptables-save dumps the current ruleset to standard output; redirecting it to /etc/iptables/rules.v4 stores the rules so they can be restored at boot on Debian-based systems.
